main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 7-bar excess forward return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with top-minus-bottom tercile > 0; reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-minus-bottom forecast tercile mean excess 7-bar return

decided_by: The slope t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: The coin's mean 7-bar return is taken over its non-overlapping samples from all windows. The OLS includes an intercept and uses the ordinary OLS standard error. Terciles are cut at the pooled 1/3 and 2/3 forecast quantiles (bottom <= q1/3, top >= q2/3).
